properties.name: spring.application.base-url
properties.description: Base API URL to access this service

properties.name: spring.application.environment
properties.description: Environment for the application (local, dev, prod)

properties.name: spring.application.auth.domain
properties.description: Domain for authentication, authorization and CORS configuration

properties.name: spring.application.auth.secure
properties.description: Secure flag for authentication cookies

properties.name: spring.application.auth.samesite
properties.description: SameSite attribute for authentication cookies

properties.name: spring.application.auth.http-only
properties.description: HttpOnly flag for authentication cookies

properties.name: jwt.public-key
properties.description: Public RSA(RS256) for JWT token verification, this key will be generated from private key of Auth service

properties.name: jwt.private-key
properties.description: Private RSA(RS256) for JWT token generation, this key will be generated from private key of Auth service

properties.name: jwt.issuer
properties.description: Token Issuance Platform

properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: Expiration for access token

properties.name: jwt.refresh-token-expiration
properties.description: Expiration for refresh token

properties.name: third-party.frontend.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for frontend application

properties.name: third-party.google.client-id
properties.description: Google OAuth client ID, used as the expected audience when verifying Google Sign-In ID tokens

properties.name: third-party.facebook.app-id
properties.description: Facebook App ID; access tokens from Facebook Login must be issued for this app

properties.name: third-party.facebook.app-secret
properties.description: Facebook App Secret, used for the app access token and appsecret_proof when calling the Graph API

properties.name: app.debug
properties.description: Include the exception class, cause and stack trace in 500 responses. Never enable in production

properties.name: third-party.facebook.graph-url
properties.description: Base URL of the Facebook Graph API

properties.name: spring.liquibase.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable Liquibase

properties.name: spring.liquibase.change-log
properties.description: Path to the Liquibase change log file

properties.name: third-party.gemini.api-key
properties.description: API key for Gemini AI service

properties.name: third-party.gemini.model
properties.description: Gemini model used by the assistant chat

properties.name: third-party.gemini.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the Gemini REST API

properties.name: third-party.groq.api-key
properties.description: API key for Groq service

properties.name: third-party.groq.model
properties.description: Groq model used by the assistant chat

properties.name: third-party.groq.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the Groq REST API
